spans.s: कु-नट m. a bad actor.
कु-नदिका f. a small river, सुपुरा स्यात्कुनदिका Panch.i.
कु-नाथ m. a bad master.
कु-नामन् m. a miser.
कुंकुम n. Saffron, कुंकुमपंककलंकितदेहा Bhartr.i.10, 25.
कुंकुम-अद्रि m. name of a mountain.
कुंचन n. Curving, bending, contraction.
कुंचि m. A measure of capacity equal to eight handfuls.
कुंचिका f. 1. A key, Bhartr.i.63; 2. the shoot of a bamboo.
कुंचित a. (f. ता) Contracted, bent, curved, (pp. of कुच् II q.v.)
कुंचित a. (f. ता) Contracted, bent, curved, (pp. of कुच् II q.v.)
कुंज m.n. 1. A place overgrown with plants or creepers, a bower, an arbour, संकेतीकृतमंजुवंजुललताकुंजेऽपि यत्रागतः Git.G.vii., R.ix.64, Megh.i.19; 2. the tusk of an elephant, ivory.
कुंज-कुटीर m. a bower, a place overgrown with plants and creepers, मधुकरनिकरकरंबितकोकिलकूजितकुंजकुटीरे Git.G.i., M.M.v.

कुंजर m. 1. An elephant; 2. anything preeminent or excellent (at the end of a compound only- स्युरुत्तरपदे व्याघ्रपुंगवर्षभकुंजराः । सिंहशार्दूलनागाद्याः पुंसि श्रेष्ठार्थवाचकाः Am.iii.1.59); 3. the Aśvattha tree; 4. the constellation called हस्त.
कुंजर-अनीक n. the division of an army consisting of elephants, an elephant corps.
कुंजर-अशन m. the Aśvattha tree.
कुंजर-अराति m. 1. a lion; 2. Śarabha, a fabulous animal with eight feet.
कुंजर-ग्रह m. an elephant catcher.
कुंटक a. (f. की) Fat, corpulent.
कुंटक a. (f. की) Fat, corpulent.
कुंठ a. (f. ठा) 1. blunt, वज्रं तपोवीर्यमहत्सि कुंठम् K.S.iii.12; 2. stupid; 3. weak, indolent.
कुंठ a. (f. ठा) 1. blunt, वज्रं तपोवीर्यमहत्सि कुंठम् K.S.iii.12; 2. stupid; 3. weak, indolent.
कुंठक m. A fool.
कुंठित a. (f. ता) 1. Blunted, dulled, कुंठितसर्वशक्तिनिकरो जातो जरातो विधिः Bh.V.ii.78, K.S.ii.20; 2. mutilated; 3. stupid.
कुंठित a. (f. ता) 1. Blunted, dulled, कुंठितसर्वशक्तिनिकरो जातो जरातो विधिः Bh.V.ii.78, K.S.ii.20; 2. mutilated; 3. stupid.
कुंड (I) m.n. 1. A bowl-shaped vessel, a basin; 2. a round hole in the ground for receiving water; 3. a pool, a well, especially one consecrated to a deity; 4. the bowl of mendicant.
कुंड (II) m. (fem. ˚डी) Son born in adultery, the son of a woman by another man than her husband while the husband is alive. See M.iii.174.
कुंड-अशिन् m. A pander, a pimp, one who depends on a Kunḍa (II) for his livelihood, Yaj.i.224.
कुंडोध्नी f. 1. cow with a full udder; 2. a woman with a full bosom.
कुंड-कीट m. 1. a keeper of concubines; 2. a follower of the chārvāka doctrine, an atheist; 3. a Brāhmaṇa born in adultery.
कुंड-कील m. a low vile man.
कुंड-गोल, -गोलक n. 1. gruel; 2. a group of कुंड and गोलक.
कुंड-गोल, -गोलक n. 1. gruel; 2. a group of कुंड and गोलक.
कुंडल m.n. 1. An ear-ring, श्रोत्रं श्रुतेनैव न कुंडलेन Bhartr.ii.71, Ch.
; 2. a bracelet; 3. the coil of a rope.
कुंडलना f. Encircling (as a word), फणिभाषितभाष्यफक्किका विषमा कुंडलनामवापिता Na.ii.95.
कुंडलिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Decorated with an ear-ring; 2. circular, spiral.
कुंडलिन् (II) m. 1. A snake, कुंडलिकुलकुंडलेन पातालम् R.G.; 2. a peacock; 3. an epithet of Varuṇa.
कुंडलिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Decorated with an ear-ring; 2. circular, spiral.
कुंडिका f. 1. A pitcher; 2. a student’s water-pot.
कुंडिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
कुंडिन m. Name of a city, the capital of the Vidarbhas.
कुंडिर m. A man.
कुनक m. A crow.
कुंत m. 1. A lance, a barbed dart, विरहिनिकृंतनकुंतमखाकृतिकेतकिदंतुरिताशे Git.G.i.; 2. a small animal, an inseet.
कुंतल (I) m. 1. The hair of the head, a lock of hair, व्यालोलकुंतलकलापवतीं स्मरामि Ch.
; 2. a drinking cup; 3. a plough.
कुंतल (II) m. pl. Name of a country and its inhabitants.
कुंति (I) m. pl. The name of a country and its people.
कुंति (II) m. Name of a king, son of क्रथ.
कुंति-सुता [or कुंती] f. Kuntī, the mother of the Pāṇḍavas and the adopted daughter of king Kunti.
कुंथ् vi. 9P (pres. कुथ्नाति) 1. To suffer pain; 2. to cling to; 3. to embrace.
कुंद (I) m.n. A kind of jasmine, प्रातः कुंदप्रसवशिथिलं जीवितं धारयेथाः Megh.ii.50.
कुंद (II) n. The flower of this plant, अलके बालकुंदानुविद्धम् Megh.ii.2, i.47.
कुंद (III) m. 1. Epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. a turner’s lathe.
कुंद-कर m. a turner.
कुंदम m. A cat.
कुंदिनी f. A multitude of lotuses.
कुंदु m. A rat, a mouse.
कुंबा f. An enclosure of the sacrificial ground.
कुंभ m. 1. A pitcher, a water-pot, a jar, हेमकुंभस्तननिःसृतानाम् R.ii.36, Am.
, Sr.

; 2. Aquarius, the eleventh sign of the zodiac; 3. a measure of grain equal to 20 droṇas, M.viii.320; 4. the frontal globe on the forehead of an elephant, मत्तेभकुंभदलने भुवि संति शूराः Bhartr.i.59; 5. closing the nostrils and mouth so as to suspend breathing (in Yoga phil.); 6. the paramour of a harlot.
कुंभा f. A harlot.
कुंभ-कार m. 1. a potter, Sr.
; 2. a mixed tribe (वेश्यायां विप्रतश्चौर्यात् कुंभकारः स उच्यते Uśanas).
कुंभ-घोण m. the name of a town.

कुंभ-ज, -जन्मन्, -योनि, -संभव m. 1. an epithet of Agastya, प्रससादोदयादंभः कुंभयोनेर्महौजसः R.iv.22, xv.55; 2. an epithet of Droṇa, the military preceptor of the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas; 3. epithet of Vasiṣṭha.

कुंभ-ज, -जन्मन्, -योनि, -संभव m. 1. an epithet of Agastya, प्रससादोदयादंभः कुंभयोनेर्महौजसः R.iv.22, xv.55; 2. an epithet of Droṇa, the military preceptor of the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas; 3. epithet of Vasiṣṭha.

कुंभ-ज, -जन्मन्, -योनि, -संभव m. 1. an epithet of Agastya, प्रससादोदयादंभः कुंभयोनेर्महौजसः R.iv.22, xv.55; 2. an epithet of Droṇa, the military preceptor of the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas; 3. epithet of Vasiṣṭha.

कुंभ-ज, -जन्मन्, -योनि, -संभव m. 1. an epithet of Agastya, प्रससादोदयादंभः कुंभयोनेर्महौजसः R.iv.22, xv.55; 2. an epithet of Droṇa, the military preceptor of the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas; 3. epithet of Vasiṣṭha.
कुंभ-दासी f. 1. a bawd, a procuress; 2. An epithet of abuse.
कुंभ-लग्न n. that time of the day in which Aquarius rises above the horizon.
कुंभ-मंडूक m. 1. a frog in a pitcher (lit.); 2. an inexperienced man who knows his own neighbourhood only (fig.)
कुंभ-संधि m. the hollow on the top of an elephant’s head between the frontal bones.
कुंभक m. 1. The base of a column; 2. suspension of breath by closing the mouth and the nostrils by the right hand (in Yoga phil.).
कुंभिका f. 1. A small pot; 2. a harlot.
कुंभीक m. The punnāga tree.
कुंभिन् m. 1. An elephant; 2. a crocodile.
कुंभिन्-नरक m. a particular hell.
कुंभिन्-मद m. rut, ichor.
कुंभिल m. 1. A thief who breaks into a house; 2. a plagiarist; 3. a wife’s brother; 4. a child of an imperfect impregnation.
कुंभीरक m. A thief, लोत्रेण गृहीतस्य कुंभीरकस्यास्ति वा प्रतिवचनम् Vikr.ii.
कुंभी f. A small water-jar.
कुंभी-नस m. a kind of venomous serpent.
कुंभी-पाक m. (sing. or pl.) a particular hell in which the wicked are baked like potter’s vessels, M.xii.76.
कुंभीक-मक्षिका f. a sort of fly.
कुंभीर m. A shark.
कुंभीरक m. A thief, लोत्रेण गृहीतस्य कुंभीरकस्यास्ति वा प्रतिवचनम् Vikr.ii.
कुंभीरक m. A thief, लोत्रेण गृहीतस्य कुंभीरकस्यास्ति वा प्रतिवचनम् Vikr.ii.
